noBadge.title: Complete the training to become a mentor
noBadge.body: To become a peer mentor, complete your program's mentoring training (a short video and a 10-question quiz) and earn the badge. Once the badge is verified this area opens by itself; no extra approval is needed.

trainingReason.notAvailable: Your program's training isn't published yet.
trainingReason.unavailable: The training can't be opened right now.

badgeVerified.title: Badge verified
badgeVerified.hint: Verified when you finish the training

keepGetting.title: Keep getting mentoring
keepGetting.body: On the Get mentoring tab you can keep discovering mentors and following your requests.

badgeMissing.title: Badge not showing?
badgeMissing.body: The badge is awarded as soon as you complete the training. If it isn't showing, refresh the page; if the problem persists, write to your program coordinator.

oneAccount.title: One account
oneAccount.body: Becoming a mentor doesn't create a separate account; your mentee and mentor activity stay in the same account.

revoked.title: Your badge was revoked
revoked.body: Without the Peer Mentor badge you can't mentor right now. Talk to your program coordinator about your ongoing mentorships.

earned.title: Your badge is verified
earned.body: You can now be a peer mentor. Create your mentor profile; once it's published, students in your program can discover you.
earned.signInAgain: Your badge was just awarded. Sign out and back in to start mentoring.

requests.empty: No requests waiting for an answer.

mentees.empty: You haven't accepted a request yet.

note.unset: You haven't set a capacity, so new requests keep coming. You can set it on the Availability and capacity tab.
note.lastPlace: Accepting one more request fills your capacity. New requests won't reach you until a place opens.
note.full: Your capacity is full. New requests won't reach you until a place opens.

wizard.title: Create your mentor profile

categories.title: Which topics can you mentor in?
categories.subtitle: Only the categories active in your program are listed. Pick at least one.

subtopics.title: Which sub-topics can you support?
subtopics.subtitle: Tick the sub-topics in the categories you picked.

experience.title: Share your experience in these topics
experience.subtitle: Add the courses you're strong in, your projects and any exchange experience.

helpWith.title: How can you help students?
helpWith.subtitle: This text stands out on your profile. Students look at it most when choosing a mentor.

documents.title: Back your experience with documents
documents.subtitle: Some documents are requested for the categories you chose. You decide what shows on your profile.

availability.title: When are you available?
availability.subtitle: Set your weekly availability and how many mentees you can work with at once.

preview.title: This is how students will see your profile
preview.subtitle: Check it before publishing. You can edit it any time from My mentor profile.

badge.title: Your badge is verified
badge.body: Once you publish your profile, students can discover you.

wizard.matchingNote: Matching uses category, sub-topic, experience and availability. A CV alone doesn't decide it.
wizard.noCategories: Your program has no active category yet. They appear here once your program coordinator turns them on.
wizard.noSubtopics: The categories you picked have no sub-topics.
wizard.subtopicsNote: In the next step you can share your experience in these topics.

experience.title: Your experience
experience.cardsSoon: Adding internships, clubs and jobs as cards with their documents is coming soon.

tips.concrete: Say where you have hands-on experience
tips.who: Say who you can help most
tips.how: Explain how you work in meetings

documents.portfolioPlaceholder: https://github.com/…, behance.net or a personal site

hints.certificate: Professional licences, certificates or documents of courses you completed
hints.other: Other documents that back your experience

documents.noRequired: Your categories need no required documents; you can still add some.
documents.drop: Drag and drop your file or
documents.safeBody: Documents you mark "For verification only" are seen only by the program coordinator, to verify them. Those you mark "Show on my profile" are visible to students.
documents.notPdf: You can only upload PDF files.
documents.tooLarge: The file can be at most {max}.
documents.linkInvalid: Enter a link that starts with https://.

wizard.draftSoon: Saving a draft is coming soon.

errors.helpWith: This text must be at least {min} characters.
errors.link: The link must start with http:// or https://.

take.title: Peer mentoring
take.subtitle: Get mentoring from METU students. Mentors are students who completed the training and hold a verified badge.

discover.noCategories: Your program has no active peer-mentoring category yet.
discover.empty: No peer mentors are listed right now.
discover.noMatch: No peer mentor matches these filters.
discover.requested: Your request is awaiting an answer

profile.notFound: This peer mentor wasn't found or is no longer listed.
profile.requestNote: Once {name} accepts your request, the mentorship starts and you can plan meetings.

dialog.title: Send a mentoring request
dialog.subtitle: {name} · Peer mentor
dialog.messagePlaceholder: For example: I'd like to go over my CV for a summer internship together.
dialog.counter: Briefly introduce yourself and what you expect (at least {min} characters). {length} / {max}
dialog.messageTooShort: Your message must be at least {min} characters.

mine.empty: You have no mentoring requests yet. Pick a peer mentor from Discover.
mine.noActive: You have no active mentorship yet.
mine.note: A mentorship is the relationship between you and your mentor. Your meetings are listed under "My appointments".

giving.title: Mentoring I give
giving.empty: No requests waiting for an answer.

training.title: Become a peer mentor
training.body: Complete your program's training, earn your badge and mentor other students.

createProfile.title: Your badge is verified
createProfile.body: Create your mentor profile; once it's published, students can discover you.
